summary: Wrote a four-phase, 3.5-hour plan siting P8, the two encoding-forced helpers (temporalPastDerived, boxToAlwaysBox) and the eleven unported Pthm:11--Pthm:22 principles in a new FormalSystem/Theorems/Interaction.lean, with Pthm:17 handled as a docstring cross-reference on perpetuity4 rather than a restatement. All sixteen signatures and proof terms were re-verified at plan time under their final semantic names by a lean_run_code probe (success: true, zero diagnostics), so the Lean Challenge Statements block is plan-time-derived rather than carried. Two plan-time findings the research report did not reach drive the phase order: C33 requires a sorted import in the ROOT FormalSystem.lean as well as FormalSystem/Theorems.lean, so both aggregator lines land in Phase 1 instead of a terminal phase (deferring would leave every intermediate commit C33-red); and the generated-inventory INV group plus typst/generated/status.typ are stale by construction from module creation until Phase 4's regeneration, so Phases 1-3 assert named checks rather than whole-script exit 0.
